Privacy Policy

Effective 16 September 2026

Note Builder is published by Essential Software. This policy describes what data the app stores, where it lives, and what leaves your device.

On-device storage

All pages, drafts, images, favourites, preferences, and UI state are stored locally on your device. If you sign in with Google, your notes are additionally backed up to Essential Software's servers — see below.

Google sign-in & sync

Signing in is optional. It's handled by Google — Essential Software never sees your Google password. Essential Software receives your Google account identifier and email address, and stores them along with a session token so you stay signed in. While signed in, your notes (including embedded images) are backed up to Essential Software's servers so they can be restored on another device, and your Pro purchase (if any) is linked to your account so it carries over too. Signing out stops further syncing but does not delete the backup already stored — sign back in to pick it up again. You can delete your account at any time by tapping the account icon and choosing Delete account under Show more. Doing so signs you out and schedules everything stored with it (synced notes, published pages) for permanent removal after 30 days. Signing back in with the same Google account during that window cancels the deletion and restores full access.

Publishing a page

Publishing is optional — it only happens when you tap Publish. Your page's content and the address you choose are sent to Essential Software and stored so the page can be served at a public link. Anyone with that link can view the page. Essential Software also gives you a private token for that page. It's stored on your device, not kept as-is on Essential Software's side — only a scrambled version of it is kept there, just enough to confirm it matches when you send it back to update or unpublish. Updating a published page sends the new content the same way. Unpublishing takes it down. A copy may be kept for up to 30 days afterward in case of an abuse report or takedown request, then deleted.

Reporting a published page

Anyone can report a published page from its public link. Reporting checks the reporter's IP address for about a minute, just to stop spam, then discards it — it's never stored as part of the report itself. Essential Software keeps only the reason and details submitted. Essential Software keeps every report on file so it can be reviewed. Reports of child sexual abuse material are specifically preserved, not deleted, because that material must be kept and passed to the proper authority.

External images & embeds

Images embedded in a page via URL are fetched directly from their source when the page is built. YouTube embeds load directly from YouTube, and Instagram post embeds load directly from Instagram. Essential Software has no involvement with these third-party hosts.

Linked pages

This section covers links inside the app. Tapping a link in a page shows its address in a sheet with a copy option. The app does not open, load, or navigate to the linked page — nothing is fetched, and Essential Software has no visibility into what links a page contains. A published page works differently: it's a plain web page viewed in a browser, so links inside it are ordinary clickable links that open like any other link on the web.

Analytics

Essential Software does not collect analytics, telemetry, or crash reports from this app.

Consumer Terms

Effective 14 September 2026

Using Note Builder means you agree to these terms.

Responsible Use

You agree to use Note Builder for lawful purposes only. You may not use the app to create, store, or export content that is illegal, harmful, threatening, abusive, defamatory, or infringes on the rights of others. This applies with extra weight to anything you publish — see below.

Your Content

Pages you build are stored on your device. If you sign in with Google, they're also backed up to Essential Software's servers so you can restore them on another device. You are responsible for keeping your own backups if you don't sign in — without an account, Essential Software has no copy of your content and cannot recover it if it's lost.

Your Account

Signing in is optional and handled by Google. Keep your Google account secure — anyone with access to it can access your synced notes and Pro entitlement through this app.

Published Content

A published page is stored on Essential Software's servers and can be viewed by anyone with the link. You're responsible for what you publish and for having the rights to it. Essential Software may remove a published page if it breaks these terms, gets a valid takedown request, or is reported and found to be abusive. Unpublish it yourself and its address frees up right away for reuse. If Essential Software removes it instead, for a takedown or abuse report, the address stays down for good and can't be reclaimed or republished.

Third-Party Content

Images and video you embed by URL are loaded directly from the source you provide. You are responsible for having the right to use any content you embed.

Changes to These Terms

Essential Software may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the app after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
